preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 100.
The length of the string s must be at least 2 and even.
The number of queries q must be between 1 and 200,000.
Each query must have valid indices l and r such that the substring length is even.

postconditions.description: The output must be the minimum cost to make the substring a correct bracket sequence.
